title: Discovering potential key biomarkers and molecular mechanisms in Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease and rheumatoid arthritis using integrated bioinformatics and machine learning approaches.
authors: Tasnim, Wahia; Mondal, M Rubaiyat Hossain
one_liner_zh: 该文用生物信息学与机器学习筛选COPD和RA共享生物标志物，虽涉及转录因子ETS1/YY1等，但核心是疾病标志物而非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，方法无三维结构或结合机制研究，仅边缘相关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) and Rheumatoid Arthritis (RA) are among the leading causes of illness and mortality globally. Many studies claim that these diseases are interconnected. However, the underlying molecular processes and shared biomarkers between RA and COPD are still undiscovered. METHODS: This research is aimed at discovering the key potential biomarkers and mechanisms in RA and COPD, incorporating several Bioinformatics and Machine Learning (ML) approaches via R programming. Several validation methods are also applied to validate the key potential biomarkers. RESULTS: By performing the differential expression analysis, we have discovered 90 common Differentially Expressed Genes (DEGs) between RA and COPD. From the Gene Set Enrichment analysis, we get the top molecular mechanisms related to the common DEGs. From the Protein Protein Interaction analysis, we get the candidate hub genes among the common DEGs. Among all the ML approaches, ElasticNet outperforms with the highest accuracy of 91.52% with a set of important genes. By intersecting the candidate hub genes and the ElasticNet important genes, we get four candidate genes, ETS1, YY1, CREBP5, and GTF2H1. Receiver Operating Characteristic (ROC) curve and Expression analysis show robust discriminatory efficacy for all four genes, while nomogram modeling further validates their predictive correlations with RA and COPD. Finally, the candidate transcription factors, microRNAs and drugs related to the potential biomarkers are also suggested. CONCLUSION: In conclusion, this research identifies the key potential molecular mechanisms and four potential biomarkers between RA and COPD. These findings could potentially improve our understanding of the molecular mechanisms behind COPD and RA by providing a preliminary basis for future experimental and clinical studies.
abstract_zh: 背景：慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）和类风湿关节炎（RA）是全球发病和死亡的主要原因之一。许多研究声称这些疾病相互关联。然而，RA与COPD之间的潜在分子过程和共享生物标志物仍未揭示。方法：本研究旨在通过R编程结合多种生物信息学和机器学习（ML）方法，发现RA和COPD中的关键潜在生物标志物及机制。同时应用多种验证方法来验证关键潜在生物标志物。结果：通过差异表达分析，我们发现了RA和COPD之间90个常见的差异表达基因（DEGs）。通过基因集富集分析，我们获得了与常见DEGs相关的顶级分子机制。通过蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用分析，我们在常见DEGs中获得了候选枢纽基因。在所有ML方法中，ElasticNet表现最佳，准确率最高达91.52%，并识别出一组重要基因。通过将候选枢纽基因与ElasticNet重要基因取交集，我们获得了四个候选基因：ETS1、YY1、CREBP5和GTF2H1。受试者工作特征（ROC）曲线和表达分析显示这四个基因均具有稳健的判别效能，而列线图建模进一步验证了它们与RA和COPD的预测相关性。最后，还提出了与潜在生物标志物相关的候选转录因子、microRNA和药物。结论：总之，本研究识别了RA和COPD之间的关键潜在分子机制及四个潜在生物标志物。这些发现可能通过为未来实验和临床研究提供初步基础，增进我们对COPD和RA背后分子机制的理解。
